input.summary: Roll over lit buttons and hit A-B to raise the center target to 400 or 500. Collect it before the next advance changes it to Special, then rebuild and repeat.

quickInfo.name: Center target
quickInfo.summary: The center drop target starts at 100 and can rise to 500 in 100-point steps.

quickInfo.name: Target advances
quickInfo.summary: Lit rollover buttons and hits on the A-B swinging targets raise the center target value.

quickInfo.name: A-B reset
quickInfo.summary: After the center target drops, another A-B completion raises and relights it.

quickInfo.name: Top bumper
quickInfo.summary: The top bumper scores 100 when lit and supplies the other major points route.

quickInfo.name: Special limit
quickInfo.summary: The next advance after 500 changes the center target to Special instead of a point value.

quickInfo.name: Outlane salvage
quickInfo.summary: Either outlane scores the current center-target value, while a center drain does not collect it.

steps.text: Check whether Special awards points before the first ball.
Read the center target value and the lit rollover buttons.
Use lit rollover buttons to advance the center target when the upper route is open.
Hit the A and B swinging targets when those advances are available.
Stop advancing the center target at 400 or 500.
Shoot the center drop target to collect its displayed point value.
Hit both A and B again to raise and relight the center target.
Repeat the build and collect route while the center rebound remains survivable.

fallback.title: Strong-flipper upper route
fallback.when: Use this plan when the flippers reach the upper playfield reliably and target rebounds are worse.

steps.text: Send the ball toward the upper playfield without hitting a bumper face.
Use lit rollover buttons to advance the center target.
Score the top bumper when its lit face is reachable through natural upper play.
Repeat the upper route while the flippers remain strong and accurate.
Collect the center target before another advance changes 500 to Special.

alternatives.title: Early 400 collect
alternatives.when: Use this plan when reaching 500 would require another dangerous advance.

steps.text: Stop the build when the center target reaches 400.
Settle the ball before the center shot.
Shoot the center target for 400.
Complete A and B to raise the target again.

alternatives.title: Outlane salvage
alternatives.when: Use this only when a drain is already unavoidable and the ball can still be nudged away from the center gap.

steps.text: Note the current center-target value before the ball reaches the drain area.
Use one legal nudge toward the nearer outlane rather than accepting a zero-value center drain.
Do not abandon a controllable ball solely to collect the outlane value.
Advance the center target with lit rollovers and A-B hits.
Stop when the display reaches 500.
Collect the center target before another advance.
Complete A and B to raise and relight the target.
Repeat the 500-point collect.

playfieldReferences.label: Center drop target
playfieldReferences.description: Central drop whose displayed award builds from 100 through 500 before changing to Special.

playfieldReferences.label: Lit rollover buttons
playfieldReferences.description: Five upper and two lower lit buttons that each advance the center-target value by 100.

playfieldReferences.label: A-B swinging targets
playfieldReferences.description: Two swinging targets that advance the center award and raise the target again after a collect.

playfieldReferences.label: Lit top bumper
playfieldReferences.description: Upper bumper worth 100 when lit and the other primary points route.

playfieldReferences.label: Center triangular wedge
playfieldReferences.description: Upward-pointing wedge between the wide-set flippers that can deflect a center ball toward either flipper.

techniques.name: Center-wedge read
techniques.instruction: Watch the ball contact the triangular wedge. Flip after a hard deflection, or wait when the ball can settle.

techniques.name: Lit-rollover advance
techniques.instruction: Read the rollover lamp before the ball arrives. Use only a lit button when the target needs another 100-point advance.

techniques.name: A-B target rebuild
techniques.instruction: Hit both swinging targets after a center collect. Confirm that the center target rises before another direct shot.

cautions.issue: A shot at either swinging target can hit the rubber behind it and rebound toward a drain.
cautions.response: Aim at the target face. Stop the A-B route if either direct hit or miss repeatedly produces a drain feed.

cautions.issue: The center target can return the ball toward the wide center gap.
cautions.response: Prepare both flippers before the shot. Read the triangular wedge before you choose to flip or settle.

cautions.issue: An advance beyond 500 changes the center target to Special and can remove its point value.
cautions.response: Check the Special award before play. Stop all target advances at 500 when Special does not award points.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm this is the single-player 1964 Williams Heat Wave and check ball count, replay, Special, and tilt settings.
Test all seven lit rollover buttons, A-B, center-target reset and rebound, top bumper, outlane scoring, wedge feeds, and flipper strength.
Verify that either outlane scores the current center-target value and that advancing beyond 500 changes the target to Special.
input.simpleOverview: Heat Wave uses lit rollovers and the A-B swinging targets to advance the center target from 100 to 500. Stop at 500, knock down the center target for points before another advance changes it to Special, then complete A-B to relight and repeat it.
input.overview: Heat Wave raises the center-target value through lit rollovers and A-B hits; the lit top bumper provides the other major scoring route. Reach 500, collect the center target before its next advance becomes Special, then complete A-B to raise and relight it. Repeat the 500-point collect and use an outlane only as a salvage collect.
